rules.source_supported_proposition: At least 200 sessions of price history required to compute the 200 SMA and 52-week price metrics.
Prior primary directional advance must be at least 30% preceding consolidation base inception.
rules.ARX_transformation_if_any: Directional net advance evaluated over pre-base window.

rules.source_supported_proposition: 8-point Trend Template: Price > 150 SMA > 200 SMA, 50 SMA > 150 SMA, 200 SMA non-declining, price within 25% of 52-wk high, >= 30% above 52-wk low.
rules.ARX_transformation_if_any: Operationalized 1 month non-declining 200 SMA as 22-session slope >= 0.

rules.source_supported_proposition: Stage 2 Advancing phase requires price above upward-trending long-term 200-day moving average.
rules.ARX_transformation_if_any: Integrated with Minervini 200 SMA slope evaluation.

rules.source_supported_proposition: Pattern typically displays 2 to 4 contractions (2T, 3T, or 4T).
rules.ARX_transformation_if_any: Bounded swing wave detector searching discrete local peaks and troughs.

rules.source_supported_proposition: Base corrections typically range 15% to 35%, with maximum permissible depth capped at 45%.
Final contraction depth must tighten to a narrow band, rarely exceeding 10% to 15%.
Each successive pullback depth must be strictly smaller than the previous pullback depth.
rules.ARX_transformation_if_any: Monotonic strict inequality check: Depth_k < Depth_{k-1} for all consecutive waves.

rules.source_supported_proposition: Volume contracts dramatically during the final tightest pullback, falling significantly below average.
rules.ARX_transformation_if_any: Operationalized as final wave average volume <= 0.70 * SMA50(Volume).

rules.source_supported_proposition: The pivot / optimal entry price is the high of the final contraction wave before breakout.
rules.ARX_transformation_if_any: Identified as peak of wave T when wave count >= 2.

rules.source_supported_proposition: Buy within a few percent of the pivot point, not chasing extended past +5%.
rules.ARX_transformation_if_any: Operationalized pre-breakout radar ready zone as [-5.0%, +2.0%] of pivot.

rules.source_supported_proposition: Operational lookback for 1-month non-declining 200-day moving average slope.
